label.purpose: Rails, order context, and compact status.

shadows.name: working-plane
shadows.purpose: Separates scenes and active preparation objects from washi.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Gives the current service action restrained tactile lift.

motion.name: placement
motion.purpose: Ingredient and dish-piece placement feedback; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:2px solid #171611; border-radius:0; background:#163a2a; color:#fff8e8; font:750 16px/1 system-ui,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgb(22 58 42 / 23%); } .ds-primary-action:hover { background:#20563c; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #24445e; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgb(22 58 42 / 20%); }

components.name: Secondary Text Action
components.description: A quiet explanatory action beside a threshold.
components.css: .ds-text-action { min-height:48px; padding:10px 2px 7px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#24445e; font:700 16px/1 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-text-action:hover { color:#163a2a; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #24445e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ingredient Tile
components.description: An exact ingredient identity with geometric recognition mark.
components.css: .ds-ingredient-tile { min-height:64px; width:100%; padding:12px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px 1fr; gap:12px; align-items:center; text-align:left; border:1px solid #24445e; border-radius:0; background:#fff8e8; color:#171611; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #24445e; } .ds-ingredient-tile:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f4d06f; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-ingredient-tile strong,.ds-ingredient-tile small { display:block; } .ds-ingredient-tile small { margin-top:5px; opacity:.72; } .ds-ingredient-mark { width:42px; height:42px; background:#f4e9d2; border:2px solid #171611; }

components.name: Active Order
components.description: The currently authored guest order on the rail.
components.css: .ds-active-order { min-height:76px; padding:12px 10px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto; gap:10px; align-items:center; border:1px solid #fff8e8; border-radius:0; background:#fff8e8; color:#171611; box-shadow:inset 5px 0 0 #c83b2d; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-active-order strong,.ds-active-order small { display:block; } .ds-active-order small { margin-top:5px; opacity:.72; } .ds-active-order em { font-size:10px; font-style:normal; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Ledger Navigation
components.description: Four-cell product navigation with one active counter destination.
components.css: .ds-ledger-nav { min-height:68px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); background:#171611; border-top:1px solid #4d483e; font:700 12px/1 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-nav a,.ds-ledger-nav span { display:grid; place-items:center; min-height:48px; color:#797163; border-right:1px solid #4d483e; } .ds-ledger-nav a[aria-current=page] { color:#fff8e8; box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 #c83b2d; } .ds-ledger-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f4d06f; outline-offset:-5px; }

narrative.overview: Samurai Sushi should feel like a tiny evening counter already in service: tactile, legible, restrained, and quietly ceremonial. The interface is an operating surface, not a promotional hero. Orders, ingredients, preparation, and network truth occupy grounded planes with an authored sequence. The visual world pairs dark lacquer rails with warm washi and rice surfaces. Pixel-like geometry and compact ledger labels supply game character without nostalgic clutter. Every state must remain truthful: walletless play is visible, unfinished capabilities are disabled, and culinary review status is never hidden.
keyCharacteristics: Hard-edged lacquer rails surrounding a broad, warm preparation plane.
Dense operational labels paired with large, decisive task headlines.
Vermilion for authored sequence, nori for action, indigo for secondary information, and brass for restrained ceremony.
Geometric ingredient and dish silhouettes that remain recognizable without color alone.

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion and brass mark sequence or status; they never become broad decorative fills.

rules.name: The One Loud Line Rule
rules.body: Only the current threshold or task receives display scale; everything else supports it.

rules.name: The Grounded Plane Rule
rules.body: A shadow may lift a working object from its surface, but rails and navigation remain fixed architectural layers.

dos: Do make the current service action the strongest line on the screen.
Do pair state color with text, position, silhouette, or a full outline.
Do keep wallet, network, culinary-review, and prototype claims visibly truthful.
Do preserve 48px controls, visible focus, and the authored ingredient-to-action sequence.
donts: Don't turn the counter into a marketing hero, dashboard grid, or rounded-card collection.
Don't use vermilion or brass as broad decorative backgrounds.
Don't communicate ingredient identity, progress, or availability by color alone.
Don't add wallet prompts before a complete settled service.
